title: Different Kinds of Music
subtitle: 考点：音乐风格 / jazz, rap, traditional
passage: There are many styles of music, and each one has its own character. Classical music is often played by an orchestra and can be calm or powerful. Jazz comes from the United States. It is full of surprises because the players often make up the music as they play. Pop songs are easy to sing along to, so they are popular with young people.

Rap is different. The performer speaks the lyrics quickly and follows a strong rhythm. Traditional music, such as Chinese folk songs, tells the stories and customs of a place. Nowadays, we can download any kind of music in seconds and listen to it on our phones. Some people like only one style, but others enjoy many kinds. As the saying goes, music has no borders.
